purpose: Define the non-downgradable training and evaluation contract for the first harder-task curiosity run.
minimum_training_sequence: Build Phase07 residual-adapter preflight from the 8-source runner output.
Train a no-curiosity Phase07 residual adapter for at least one GPU-hour as the harder-task learned baseline.
Build Phase07 curiosity-forward preflight from the same train/validation source split without held-out leakage.
Train the Phase07 curiosity forward model for at least one GPU-hour and save initial and final checkpoints.
Compute learning-progress curiosity from initial versus trained forward-model checkpoints.
Train a Phase07 curiosity-weighted residual adapter for at least one GPU-hour from the Phase07 source split.
Evaluate no-adaptation, scripted feedback, no-curiosity residual, curiosity-weighted residual, and ablations on held-out cells with complete rollout videos.
known_limitations_before_training: Visual fill cue is currently metadata-only under candidate.task.* and is not rendered as liquid, hidden occlusion, or misleading evidence.
Current tactile evidence is Newton contact proxy, not calibrated tactile F6 or real tactile-marker deformation.

Curiosity-weighted residual adaptation is an intermediate supervised policy-update path, not a full RL algorithm; it cannot alone close the final user objective without held-out closed-loop evaluation and stronger ablations.
valid_use: Pre-training contract for Phase07 harder-task runs
No-downgrade gate before Phase07 training and evaluation
Audit trail for train/validation/held-out split preservation
